parsed.lessons_learned: I identified the fragmentation problem for 3 consecutive cycles but only partially acted on it each time. This cycle I executed the full consolidation rather than just trimming one position. Talk is cheap — actually cutting the dead weight matters more than incremental gestures. Going forward, act decisively on lessons in the same cycle they're identified rather than spreading the fix across multiple cycles.
